content: एध् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (एधते, एधाञ्चके, ऐधिष्ट, एधितुम्, एधित) .²1 To grow, increase; विनापि संगमं स्त्रीणां कवीनां सुखमेधते <ls>Pt. 2. 164</ls>. .²2 To prosper, become happy, live in comfort; द्वावेतौ सुखमेधेते <ls>Pt. 1. 318</ls>. .²3 To grow strong, become great. .²4 To extend. .²5 To swell, rise. . --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause to grow or increase; to greet, celebrate, honour; नैदिधः स्वपराकम् <ls>Bk. 15. 19</ls>; (तां) आशीर्भिरेधयामासुः <ls>Ku. 6. 90</ls>. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} एदिधिषते
